text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?
reply_text: You first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug, in #inc-vtg-hartford. The guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard during the outage, per your same post. Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03 AM, when the guard checked in trailer 8836, and both lanes were working by 11:07 AM. The channel has nothing more on the guard between 10:42 and 11:03, so the guard's own log or dispatch records would be the place to check for that. I replied to you in the thread on your message.

text: And mine: which ticket holds the status-page screenshot for Mateo's access problem?
